Binance Hack-Linked Wallets Move $137M in ETH, Bitget Hackers Transfer $161M in BTC Addresses linked to the Binance hack transferred 74,881 ETH worth approximately $137 million within one hour on November 17, according to on-chain analyst Ember. Separately, Arkham reported that wallets linked to the September 24 Bitget hack moved 2,266.68 BTC worth around $161 million over the past 11 days, with most funds sent to mixing services and CoinJoin addresses. Some assets were transferred to newly untagged addresses, leaving their ultimate destination unclear. — link

Bitcoin Spot ETFs See $7.99M in Net Inflows, Ethereum ETFs Record $8.31M in Outflows According to SoSoValue, on November 16 (ET), U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded net inflows of $7.99 million, led by BlackRock's IBIT with $76.5 million in inflows. Spot Ethereum ETFs saw net outflows of $8.31 million, with Fidelity's FETH recording the largest outflow at $4.99 million. — link

Solana Foundation Takes Majority Stake in CoinGecko Solana Foundation member Vibhu confirmed that the foundation now holds a majority interest in CoinGecko, the crypto data platform. CoinGecko plans to expand its data and API infrastructure, enhance coverage of on-chain assets, RWAs and derivatives, and explore trading and DeFi services powered by Solana. CoinGecko said it will maintain its cross-chain coverage and transparent methodology. The exact ownership percentage and transaction value were not disclosed. — link

October 2026 Exchange Spot Volume Report: total $623.6 billion, MoM decreased 9.3% According to WuBlockchain data, spot trading volume across 14 major crypto exchanges totaled $623.6 billion in October 2026, down 9.3% from $687.7 billion in September. Five exchanges recorded month-over-month increases, while nine saw declines. Binance ranked first with $279.2 billion (44.8% share), followed by OKX at $61.9 billion (9.9%) and Bybit at $50.9 billion (8.2%). The top three exchanges accounted for a combined 62.9% of total volume. The figures have been adjusted for outliers but may still include wash trading and bot activity. — link
